messages:
maria: Heads-up — planning coordinated bump to v0.15.0 for API, runtime, console, and SDKs tomorrow 10:00am PT. Short checklist, please ACK if you own a repo or call blockers:
- API: tag release, changelog, verify contract tests
- runtime: compatibility matrix + canary config
- console: package.json pin + changelog UI strings
- SDKs: release notes + backwards-compat check

sam: ack runtime. I'll add canary pool and a CPU fallback policy. Will also run quick perf sanity by 8:30am PT.

jules: ack SDKs. I have one breaking doc tweak — will include in changelog. PR: draft/rel-notes/sdk-v0.15.0 (WIP)

kevin: console ack. Freezing UI copy at 8:15am PT, then will update package.json to point at api@0.15.0. Quick Q: do we want the console to fallback to api@0.14.x if runtime fails?

maria: prefer hard pin + graceful error; fallback creates client mismatch risk. If you need a fallback, make it opt-in behind feature flag.

release-bot: deployment window reserved: 2024-05-12T17:00:00Z -> 2024-05-12T19:00:00Z. Tagging reminders scheduled.

ci-bot: CI note — please ensure cross-repo e2e tests run with matrix: {api:0.15.0, runtime:canary, console:local}. Command: ```./scripts/e2e_matrix.sh --api v0.15.0 --runtime canary --console local```

sam: putting a short canary plan in the runtime PR: route 5% traffic to canary for 30m then 25% for 30m, then 100% if green. Logging hooks added.

jules: SDK release checklist: bump package.json, add changelog entry, upload artifacts, publish. ETA for final PR: 9:30am PT tomorrow.

kevin: noted on opt-in flag, will create console flag named `USE_API_FALLBACK` and default to false. Will also add a changelog note about expected behavior.

maria: small reminder — please add a one-line summary to the top of each changelog entry with the impact (e.g., "runtime: improved batching — lower token latency"). Helps product docs people.

sam: will do. Also tagging @oncall in runtime PR for 24h post-rollout.

maria: OK, thanks all. If you can't finish by freeze, say so now. Otherwise we'll proceed with the timeline. :thumbsup:

kevin: all green from console side.

jules: SDK PR merged at 09:27am PT. published draft artifacts.

sam: runtime canary deployed at 09:55am PT. Monitoring.

maria: final: I'll cut API tag at 10:00am PT unless someone objects. 2 min heads-up then I'll run `git tag -a v0.15.0 -m "release v0.15.0" && git push --tags`.

kevin: no objections. glhf.
